name: HRA 3D Reference Object Library
coverage: female abdomen/pelvis organs; vasculature; adipose; omentum; lymph-node microanatomy
limitations: uneven detail; no stomach in united-female v1.10; no complete abdominal lymphatic network

name: NLM Visible Human Female
limitations: one donor; raw images are not labeled meshes

name: AMOS22
coverage: 15 abdominal organs including stomach and uterus/prostate by sex
limitations: multi-disease cohort; patient-specific; no ovaries/fallopian tubes/lymphatic network

name: Healthy-Total-Body-CTs TCIA
license: CC BY 4.0 for segmentations and clinical data
limitations: source CT is controlled access; grouped labels; reproductive detail not assured

name: TotalSegmentator
coverage: 117-class total; abdominal muscles; gated tissue/fat tasks
license: Apache-2.0 for open tasks; separate license for tissue_types/tissue_4_types
limitations: task-specific rights; not a medical device; abdominal_muscles only T4-L4 and trained on smaller data

name: Open3Dmodel AnatomyTOOL
limitations: share-alike boundary; confirm exact downloadable package and alignment

name: BodyParts3D
limitations: official README identifies an adult human male

name: University of Dundee CAHID models
coverage: pelvic floor ligaments lymphatics and teaching models
limitations: many models are NC NoAI or non-downloadable; license must be checked per asset

name: The Period App female reproductive system
limitations: high polygon count but no academic provenance or anatomist approval found

name: BioDigital Human
limitations: free viewing does not grant reusable mesh rights
